title: UN climate talks run into overtime as countries clash over fossil fuel cuts
description: Deep divisions over fossil fuels and financial support for poorer nations pushed the Cop31 climate summit in Turkey beyond its scheduled closing day on Friday, as nearly 200 countries struggled to agree on how to tackle global warming.

title: NASA Scientists Find Clues to Ancient Ice Beyond Neptune

title: Advocates Seek To Reinstate Fossil Fuel Pledge In U.N. Climate Deal
description: Environmental advocates and some countries are pressing negotiators at the ongoing United Nations climate summit to reinstate a call to transition away from fossil fuels in a final agreement from the meeting, after a revised draft of the deal omitted any references to fossil fuels that are widely seen as a primary cause of global warming.
